source_selection: The package build consumes upstream master or the explicit KIMI_TOMLPLUSPLUS_SOURCE checkout.
license_source: LICENSE from the exact checkout consumed by the package build is copied without modification.
incorporation: kimi_config.cpp includes the toml++ header-only parser. The adapter calls its configuration transformations directly; the helper references code_home from the same translation unit. Those two executables reference the config archive member. The quota probe links kimi_provider but its referenced quota, account and launcher translation units do not reference the config member; it is not marked as a toml++ resource. The attached process bridge links the SDK alone.
